notes: 32-channel NVR (Hanwha WiseNet series), Intel 12th-gen based, 8 SATA HDD bays (up to 10TB each, max 80TB), up to 32MP camera recording. Interface data pulled from the manufacturer's official Specifications tab (Interface/Electrical/Mechanical sections). Caveats: (1) HDMI version/generation is not stated in the spec — only max resolution/refresh per port — so no HDMI grade was set; (2) Alarm In/Out and AC power inlet connector *styles* are not explicitly named in the spec (only counts/voltage given) — euroblock (terminal block) and IEC were used as the closest/most typical connector match and should be verified against the datasheet PDF or product photos if precise connector shape matters; (3) chassis dimensions (438.0 x 86.0 x 434.9 mm) are close to a 2U rack pitch but the manufacturer page never states "rack mountable" or gives a rack-unit figure, so rackUnits was left unset rather than assumed; (4) This is the base "B2" (non-redundant-PSU) variant; a "-RB2" variant with dual PSU/failover also exists — do not conflate specs. Storage-capacity SKU variants (10TB-60TB preinstalled HDD, sold via retailers like B&H) do not change the physical I/O described here.

ports.name: HDMI 1
ports.note: Playback/Setup display; max 3840x2160 @30Hz. HDMI version not stated by manufacturer (only resolution/refresh given), so grade omitted.

ports.name: HDMI 2
ports.note: Secondary display; max 1920x1080 @60Hz. HDMI version not stated by manufacturer, so grade omitted.

ports.name: Alarm In
ports.note: 8 circuits. Manufacturer spec lists only 'In 8EA'; exact connector style not stated, euroblock/terminal block inferred as the industry-standard connector for NVR alarm I/O.

ports.name: Alarm Out
ports.note: 4 circuits. Connector style inferred (terminal block), not explicitly stated by manufacturer.

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: 1EA AC inlet, 100-240VAC ±10% 50/60Hz, 1.5A (single SMPS). Exact inlet style (IEC C13/C14) inferred as typical for this chassis class; manufacturer spec only states 'AC 1EA'.
